title: Test Runs panel is extremely sluggish without a filter: keystrokes lag until state=running is set
outcome: The Test Runs panel stays responsive (typing and filtering without perceptible lag) with the full unfiltered run history of a busy host.
acceptance: A measurement on a realistic run history (at least the size of the central host's history on 2026-10-20) shows where the time goes: rendering, filtering, polling or state size.
A fix keeps keystroke-to-render latency in the panel's filter input under a stated bound with the full history and no filter, and a test or benchmark guards it.
